admission_requirements.general_requirements: General Tawjihi certificate or equivalent; minimum 60% for most majors, 80% for engineering and computer engineering [uncertain - admission criteria PDF not accessible]
admission_requirements.english_requirement: TOEFL or IELTS required for master's programs; not specified for bachelor's programs

majors_overview.notes: Homepage statistics: 23 departments, 2 centers, 9 faculties, 3730 students, 7224 graduates. Faculty of Physical Education listed in Arabic but not English version [uncertain].

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: 480-1500 JOD per year based on 30 credit hours (16-50 JOD per credit hour)
tuition_fees.notes: Discounts for new students; installment plans available; semester fees: 250 JOD for fall/spring, 180 JOD for summer; insurance 50 JOD one-time. Detailed fee schedule available as image on bsc page.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan, Higher Education Accreditation Commission

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No accommodation facilities mentioned on the website. A healthcare center (مركز الرعاية الصحية) is listed among university departments.
campus_facilities.library_details: Founded 2009, 1654 sqm, 33859 books (Arabic/English), 99 print journals, subscribes to EBSCO database (192600 titles), 20 computer lab workstations, open Saturday-Wednesday 8am to end of official working hours.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Erasmus+ exchange program with University of Jaen, Spain; tuition discounts for new students; installment payment plans.
